<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import {
  ContextMenuContent,
  type ContextMenuContentEmits,
  type ContextMenuContentProps,
  ContextMenuPortal,
  useForwardPropsEmits,
} from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<ContextMenuContentProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<ContextMenuContentEmits>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <ContextMenuPortal>
    <ContextMenuContent
      v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
      class="sigma-ui-context-menu-content"
      :class="$attrs.class"
      data-slot="context-menu-content"
    >
      <slot />
    </ContextMenuContent>
  </ContextMenuPortal>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-context-menu-content {
  z-index: 50;
  min-width: 8rem;
  padding: 0.25rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--backdrop-filter-blur));
  background-color: var(--popover);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  color: var(--popover-foreground);
  transform-origin: var(--reka-context-menu-content-transform-origin);
}

.sigma-ui-context-menu-content[data-state="open"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-fade-in-scale 200ms ease-out;
}

.sigma-ui-context-menu-content[data-state="closed"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-fade-out-scale 100ms ease-in forwards;
}
</style>

  useForwardPropsEmits,

  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));

  align-items: center;
  padding: 0.375rem 0.5rem;

  cursor: default;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  line-height: 1.25rem;
  outline: none;
  user-select: none;
}

.sigma-ui-context-menu-item--inset {
  padding-left: 2rem;
}

.sigma-ui-context-menu-item:focus {
  background-color: var(--secondary);
  color: var(--secondary-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-context-menu-item[data-disabled] {
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}
</style>
